scientific_integrity: Every finite graph adjacency decision has a supplied exact integer or rational witness; verified by standalone Python 3 checker. Previously published f-vector counts explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Finite case of exactly four labelled nodes and maximum indegree two. No claims for score-improving walks or larger dimensions. Historical priority provisional.
title: Complete three-step graph metric of the four-node bounded-indegree characteristic-imset polytope
